description: Diagnose and heal iGPU display output (left eye) on AMD gates. Detects CSM lock, UMA allocation, and iGPU enable state. Prescribes fix via UEFI variable write at boot time.

applies_to.notes: Tested on ASUS ROG STRIX X870E-E + Ryzen 9 9950X3D. Pattern applies to any AMD AM5 board with AMI BIOS.

steps.explanation: CSM enabled â†’ ASUS firmware hides NB Configuration menu AND disables iGPU display engine. This is the root cause on most ASUS X870E boards.
UMA Frame Buffer Size. 0xFFFFFFFF = Auto (no allocation). 0x06 = 512MB. Values: 0x01=64M, 0x02=128M, 0x03=256M, 0x04=384M, 0x05=512M or 0x06=512M (board-dependent), up to 0x0E=16G.
Integrated Graphics enable. Must be Force (0x01) when dGPU is present and you want both.
Primary Video Device. Keep as PCIE (0x02) so dGPU stays primary.
If LG monitor parent is BasicDisplay, iGPU has no driver. If parent is VEN_1002, amdgpu is loaded.
iGPU audio at 1002:1640 proves silicon exists. If display function (1002:164E or similar) is missing, display engine not initialized.

runtime_attempts.notes: ASUS WMI locks most settings. Will likely fail with Error 26.
ASUS applies UEFI Variable Lock during DXE. Runtime writes blocked.

boot_time_fixes.notes: Writes UEFI vars before OS loads. ASUS lock not yet applied at GRUB time.

boot_time_fixes.path: Device Manager > AMD CBS > NBIO Common Options > GFX Configuration

steps: Short CMOS clear jumper (or remove battery 30s)
Advanced > NB Configuration > Integrated Graphics > Force
Advanced > NB Configuration > UMA Frame Buffer Size > 512M

boot_time_fixes.build: viva-uefi or uefi-rs crate, no_std, target x86_64-unknown-uefi
boot_time_fixes.notes: Sovereign Rust EFI app. Reads AMD_PBS_SETUP, patches bytes, writes back. Self-contained.

linux_runtime.notes: Only works if amdgpu driver loads (chicken-and-egg: needs UMA allocated first). Works for CHANGING size after initial allocation.

post_fix_checks: Get-PnpDevice -Class Display shows AMD Radeon iGPU
LG monitor parent is PCI\VEN_1002 (not BasicDisplay)
Second display appears in Display Settings

knowledge.root_cause: CSM (Compatibility Support Module) enabled â†’ ASUS firmware disables iGPU display engine and hides NB Configuration BIOS menu. UMA Frame Buffer Size defaults to 0xFFFFFFFF (Auto = no allocation).
knowledge.why_csm_kills_igpu: CSM enables legacy BIOS compatibility. Legacy BIOS doesn't support multi-GPU or iGPU+dGPU. ASUS firmware logic: if CSM=ON, assume single-GPU legacy boot â†’ disable iGPU entirely.
knowledge.why_runtime_locked: ASUS applies EDKII VARIABLE_LOCK_PROTOCOL during DXE phase. All AMD_PBS_SETUP, Setup, and related vars locked before ExitBootServices. Only writable from UEFI Shell/app before OS loads.
knowledge.silicon_proof: iGPU audio (1002:1640) at PCI bus 123 proves Zen 5 IOD has RDNA 2 CUs. Display engine exists but firmware never enabled it. EDID from LG detected via I2C/DDC through mobo HDMI even without display engine active.

pattern_reuse.generalization: Any AMD gate with AMI BIOS + iGPU + dGPU may hit this. The tissue pattern: diagnose â†’ check CSM â†’ check UMA â†’ prescribe boot-time fix â†’ verify.
pattern_reuse.future: Once biomeOS has UEFI-layer access (via sourDough EFI app), this becomes fully autonomous self-healing.
